author: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5), agent author of UX.TOKENS.SPACE; the durations (100, 150 and 200 ms, panels at most 250 ms) and the 0 ms reduced-motion durations were chosen for this project. The easing curves are not original: their numbers match Material Design's published standard (0.2, 0, 0, 1), decelerate (0, 0, 0.2, 1) and accelerate (0.4, 0, 1, 1) cubic Bezier curves, which were consulted as a reference for those numbers only
